title: Fix E0034: keep the Write trait out of module scope
head: fix/startup-log-ambiguity
body:
Fixes the compile error introduced by the startup-failure logging merge.

`use std::io::Write` at module scope made `File::by_ref()` ambiguous (`Read::by_ref` vs `Write::by_ref`), so every Rust step failed with `error[E0034]` at `src/lib.rs:1059`.

- The reporter now calls `std::io::Write::write_all(&mut file, ..)` explicitly.
- The module-level import is back to `io::Read` only, so `migrate_legacy_storage_history_file` is unchanged.
- `tests/startup-contract.test.mjs` now asserts both rules.

Verified locally: the reporter compiles and runs standalone with rustc, `npm run test:startup` 6/6, `cargo fmt --check` clean, `npm run test:source` clean.
